# Toojibee (توجیبی)

> Toojibee is a bilingual (Persian/English) personal planning app built around time: a Persian (Solar Hijri) calendar shown alongside the Hijri and Gregorian dates, with daily occasions and official holidays in Iran, plus tasks, habits, events and reminders. Website: https://toojibee.ir

Toojibee's Hijri dates follow Iran's official calendar (month starts from the Calendar Center of the University of Tehran Institute of Geophysics) rather than a purely arithmetic calendar. The "today's date" page is generated on the server each day for Tehran time.

## Pages

- [Today's date in Iran (Persian)](https://toojibee.ir/fa/today/): تاریخ امروز به شمسی، قمری و میلادی، مناسبت‌ها و تعطیلی امروز و هفت روز آینده
- [Today's date in Iran (English)](https://toojibee.ir/en/today/): today in Solar Hijri, Hijri and Gregorian, with today's occasions and the week ahead
- [Home (Persian)](https://toojibee.ir/fa/): توجیبی، تقویم و برنامه‌ریزی روزانه، کارها و عادت‌ها
- [Home (English)](https://toojibee.ir/en/): overview of the app
- [Guide](https://toojibee.ir/en/guide/): how to use tasks, habits, events and the calendar
- [About](https://toojibee.ir/en/about/)
- [Articles](https://toojibee.ir/fa/articles/): writing on planning, habits and time management
